source.name: Brighton & Hove Albion: American Express - Main Club Partner
source.quote: sponsorship of the men's, women's and disability teams' shirts since 2013, and in 2021 we announced a long term extension

source.name: Brighton & Hove Albion: Experience Kissimmee announces partnership with Albion (archived 11 June 2024)
source.note: Three-year sleeve partnership announced 11 June 2024, running into 2026/27; the club's current partner page (https://www.brightonandhovealbion.com/partner-and-sponsors) still lists Experience Kissimmee as 'Official Sleeve Sponsor'.
source.quote: Experience Kissimmee has secured promotional rights as a sleeve partner on the men's, women's and academy shirts

source.name: Brighton & Hove Albion: Pinterest and Brighton & Hove Albion Women partner to bring inspiration to every game
source.quote: will see Pinterest become the first solo sponsor of our women's team with their branding to appear on the back of our shirts

summary: American Express on the front, Experience Kissimmee on the sleeve, and Pinterest - the women's team's first solo sponsor - on the back.
